lang.name: English
app.title: Subgen — subtitles and translation
msg.busy: Wait until the current operation finishes.
msg.close_busy: Wait until it finishes (to stop processing, press “Stop”), otherwise a file or a model may be left incomplete.
gen.drop: Drag episodes or a folder here
gen.drop_hint: MKV, MP4, AVI, WebM, MOV — the result is always MKV, the original goes to the Recycle Bin
gen.embedded: Use embedded subtitles in the source language (no generation)
gen.unsupported: the translator does not support this pair
col.title: Title
type.subtitle: subtitles
trk.hint: Select a video or drag it into the window
trk.note: Video tracks cannot be deleted. Changes are saved to MKV, the original goes to the Recycle Bin.
trk.count: Streams: {n}. Edit the fields and press “Apply”.
trk.confirm_delete: Delete tracks {list}? The original file will go to the Recycle Bin.
trk.applied: Done: the changes are applied, the original is in the Recycle Bin. The list shows the new file.
log.tracks_done: Tracks changed: {path} (the original is in the Recycle Bin)
mdl.whisper_hint: With an NVIDIA GPU choose large-v3-turbo. Without one — small or medium (slow on the CPU). .en models understand English only.
mdl.tr_hint: Google is online and does not work through some VPNs. Offline models work without the internet. OPUS-MT translates only from English to Russian.
mdl.not_yet: {key} is not downloaded yet — it will download automatically on the first run, or press “Download”.
mdl.confirm_delete: Delete the model {key}? You can download it again later.
w.small: for weak PCs without a GPU
err.incomplete: the model {key} did not download completely
err.lang_code: track #{i}: the language must be a three-letter ISO 639-2 code (eng, rus, jpn), not “{lang}”
err.last_video: the last video track cannot be deleted
err.no_ffmpeg: ffmpeg not found. Run install.cmd or: winget install --id Gyan.FFmpeg -e
err.no_audio: the file has no audio track
err.en_only: the model {key} recognizes English only, but the source language is {lang}. Choose a model without .en on the “Models” tab
err.target_exists: {name} already exists next to it, not overwriting
err.duration: the duration does not match ({a} s vs {b} s)
err.untagged: embedded track #{i} has no language or an unknown one (“{lang}”) — choose the source language explicitly
err.no_speech: no speech found — the subtitles are empty
log.downloading_model: Downloading the model {key} (~{size}), this happens only once...
log.en_only: The model {key} understands English only — the source language is assumed to be English.
log.gpu_fail:
!! The GPU (CUDA) failed: {error}
!! Switching to the CPU — this will be noticeably slower.
log.gpu_fail_tr:
!! The GPU (CUDA) failed for translation: {error}
!! Switching to the CPU.
log.tr_partial: !! Warning: {failed} of {total} lines were left untranslated (the original text is kept).
log.long_path: The path is too long for the Recycle Bin, the original was renamed: {name}
log.no_embedded: No embedded text subtitles — generating with Whisper.
log.no_embedded_lang: No embedded text subtitles ({lang}) — generating with Whisper.
log.same_lang: The source language is the same as the target language ({lang}) — no translation needed.
log.hint_google: Google Translate is unavailable (probably because of a VPN). Turn off the VPN or choose an offline translator on the “Models” tab
log.hint_offline: the offline translator failed or does not support this language pair (see above)
log.tr_failed:
!! TRANSLATION FAILED: {hint}. A new translation track was NOT added.
!! Process this .mkv again — the program's tracks will be replaced.
log.keep_old: The program's previous translation track was kept.
log.saved: Subtitles saved next to the video: {names}
cli.desc: Subtitles in the original language (Whisper) and a translation, muxed into MKV.
cli.embedded: use embedded subtitles in the source language (no generation)
cli.source: source language (default auto — detected by Whisper)
cli.nothing: Drag a video file or a folder with episodes onto the Subgen shortcut, or pass them on the command line.
